content.text: Skip to main content Starting XI XI Notes Presented by Bimbo | Philadelphia Union at CF Montreal Saturday, Apr 11, 2026, 12:30 PM Copy URL Share on X Philadelphia Union continue their April road trip north of the border with a battle against CF Montreal. Kick off from Canada is set for 2:30PM with coverage on Apple TV and 97.5 The Fanatic. STARTING XI Andre Blake; Nathan Harriel, Olwethu Makhanya, Japhet Sery, Frankie Westfield; Ben Bender, Jesus Bueno, Jovan Lukic, Indiana Vassilev; Bruno Damiani, Milan Iloski. BENCH: Andrew Rick; Geiner Martinez, Phillipe Ndinga, Finn Sundstrom, Alejandro Bedoya, Jeremy Rafanello, Cavan Sullivan, Ezekiel Alladoh, Malik Jakupovic MLS - Regular SeasonSaturday April 11 FinalMTL12PHIMatch Details Lineup notes Philadelphia Union make two changes to the Starting XI from last week's match at Charlotte FC. Olwethu Makhanya's start today marks the 35th career appearance for Philadelphia Union in MLS action. Ben Bender earns his first MLS start of 2026. The start is the fifth of his Union career in league play with the last coming June 29th against the Columbus Crew. Jovan Lukic start in the midfield this afternoon is the 35th of his Union career in MLS play. Indiana Vassilev makes his 95th career start in MLS play this afternoon in Montreal. Bruno Damiani makes his 30th career start for the Boys in Blue in league play.
